dedupeResult: The active pull-request dataset was searched for both station names, call signs, domains, submission pages and published Music Department addresses before insertion. No prior KVRX or KDVS canonical opportunity was found. KVRX's digital mailbox, physical address, operations question mailbox and AI-origin exclusion were consolidated into one station record; only the Music Department submission route was queued. KDVS's FAQ addresses, department-routing labels, Music Director mailbox and physical-only instruction were consolidated into one record; only the authorized physical route was queued.
emailVerificationLevel: KVRX publishes music@kvrx.org in plaintext on its official Contact page specifically for airplay submissions; syntax, first-party domain alignment, explicit purpose and current activity were verified. KDVS publishes musicdept@kdvs.org in plaintext for its current Music Directors; syntax, first-party domain alignment, role purpose and current activity were verified, but the same page states that new music is physical-only, so this mailbox was classified as a business contact rather than a digital submission route. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, form, audio file, download link, attachment, physical package, courier booking, customs declaration, AI-origin claim, rights statement or payment was sent. KVRX's operations mailbox was not used as a duplicate route, KDVS's Music Director mailbox was not used to bypass its physical-only rule, and no CAPTCHA, authentication, anti-bot, payment or platform restriction was entered or bypassed. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
